cards.name: Utter Insignificance
lines: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 1/1.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 1/1.

cards.name: Virulent Silencer
lines: Whenever a nontoken artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an artifact creature you control that isn't a token deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.

cards.name: Blazing Archon
lines: Creatures can't attack you.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only attack-restriction static (attackRestriction) always also covers the controller's planeswalkers, and no static stops creatures attacking only the controller.

cards.name: White Orchid Phantom
lines: When this creature enters, destroy up to one target nonbasic land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: An 'up to one' target followed by destroy and then the controller's basic land search has no single composable effect form.

cards.name: Scrounging Skyray
lines: Whenever you discard one or more cards, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discardsCard trigger has no aggregate ('one or more cards') form and no discard-count value exists for 'that many' +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Clear the Mind
lines: Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary only for the controller, with no form that shuffles a target player's graveyard into that player's library.

cards.name: Vendilion Clique
lines: When ~ enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the target player's chosen card from hand go to the bottom of their library followed by that player drawing a card; revealHandAndDiscard discards and putFromHandOnLibraryTop places cards on top.

cards.name: Barrow-Blade
lines: Whenever equipped creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, that creature loses all abilities until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a creature lose all abilities until end of turn (loseAllAbilities exists only as a static layer-6 op), so the trigger's effect cannot be written.

cards.name: Hearthborn Battler
lines: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent.

cards.name: Consign to Memory
lines: Counter target triggered ability or colorless spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A stack-object target cannot be a triggered ability or a colorless spell at once, since stackKind names one kind and no selector tests for colorless.

cards.name: Electrolyze
lines: ~ deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.
cards.backTranslation:
Choose one or two targets, each any target. This spell deals 2 damage divided as you choose among them.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Leonin Relic-Warder
lines: When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The already-parsed enters trigger exiles the target with an unlinked exile, and the schema has no effect that returns that exiled card to the battlefield when this creature leaves (returnExiledAttachedCard is hideaway-specific and the exile is not tied to this source).

cards.name: Omnath, Locus of Creation
lines: Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 4 life if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. If it's the second time, add {R}{G}{W}{U}. If it's the third time, ~ deals 4 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker you don't control.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever a land you control enters, check how many times this ability has resolved this turn, counting this resolution.
If it is the first time, you gain 4 life.
If it is the second time, add four mana, one each of {R}, {G}, {W}, and {U}.
If it is the third time, each opponent takes 4 damage, and each planeswalker controlled by an opponent takes 4 damage.

cards.name: Zero Point Ballad
lines: Destroy all creatures with toughness X or less. You lose X life. If X is 6 or more, return a creature card put into a graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mass destroy of creatures with toughness X or less needs a toughness-at-most selector, and the schema only has toughnessAtLeast.

cards.name: Smoke Shroud
lines: When a Ninja you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to that creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Ninja you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to that Ninja. This ability works while this card is in your graveyard.

cards.name: Indomitable Archangel
lines: Artifacts you control have shroud as long as you control three or more artifacts.
cards.backTranslation: As long as you control three or more artifacts, each artifact you control has shroud.

cards.name: Pia's Revolution
lines: Whenever a nontoken artifact is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, return that card to your hand unless target opponent has this enchantment deal 3 damage to them.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot say "unless target opponent has this enchantment deal 3 damage to them" as an opponent's choice that replaces the return-to-hand effect (unlessPays only takes a mana cost).

cards.name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
lines: When ~ enters, you may discard a card. If you do, search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The library search must happen only if a discard was actually made, and no effect ties a search to a completed discard (mayDiscardThenDraw only draws).

cards.name: Batterbone
lines: Living weapon
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token. Attach this to that token.

cards.name: Skyserpent Seeker
lines: Exhaust — {4}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal two land cards. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect reveals cards until two land cards are found and puts those lands onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Cat Collector
lines: Whenever you gain life for the first time during each of your turns, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The gainsLife trigger has no 'first time each turn' qualifier (only losesLife has firstTimeEachTurn), so 'the first time you gain life each turn' cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Elven Passage
lines: {T}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. You may behold an Elf. If you do, untap that land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional 'behold an Elf' choice (choose an Elf you control or reveal an Elf card from your hand, then untap that land if you did) has no schema form.

cards.name: Leonin Arbiter
lines: Players can't search libraries. Any player may pay {2} for that player to ignore this effect until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no rule static that stops players from searching libraries, so the 'players can't search libraries' restriction and the pay-{2} exception to it cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Lily Bowen, Raging Grandma
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, double the number of +1/+1 counters on ~ if its power is 16 or less. Otherwise, remove all but one +1/+1 counter from it, then you gain 1 life for each +1/+1 counter removed this way.
cards.backTranslation:
At the beginning of your upkeep, do the following.
If this creature's power is 16 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, you gain life equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature minus one. Then remove that many +1/+1 counters from this creature.

cards.name: Ring of Evos Isle
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature if it's blue.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature if it is blue.

cards.name: Shadow Alley Denizen
lines: Whenever another black creature you control enters, target creature gains intimidate until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Intimidate is not a KeywordAbility in the schema (IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS has no intimidate), so target creature cannot gain it until end of turn.

cards.name: Blightbeetle
lines: Creatures your opponents control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.
cards.backTranslation: If a +1/+1 counter would be put on a creature an opponent controls, put zero +1/+1 counters on it instead.

cards.name: Kaalia, Zenith Seeker
lines: When ~ enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an Angel card, a Demon card, and/or a Dragon card from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at-top-six choice allows at most one Angel, one Demon and one Dragon, but the schema's mayPut filter can only take a count of any matching cards, so it would also allow two Angels or two Dragons.

cards.name: Lodestone Golem
lines: Nonartifact spells cost {1} more to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static raises the cost of all nonartifact spells for every player; the only cost-increase static, opponentNonHandSpellCostIncrease, is limited to opponents' non-hand spells.

cards.name: Éowyn, Shieldmaiden
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if another Human entered the battlefield under your control this turn, create two 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste. Then if you control six or more Humans, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another Human that entered this turn, create two 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste. Then if you control six or more Humans, draw a card.
differences: Text A's intervening-if is satisfied when another Human entered the battlefield under your control this turn, even if it has since left; Text B requires a Human you currently control that entered this turn, so a Human that entered and then left the battlefield satisfies A but not B.

cards.name: Growth Spasm
lines: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."
cards.backTranslation:
Search for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle.
Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {C}."

cards.name: Welcome the Dead
lines: Draw two cards, then discard a card and you lose 2 life. Create X tapped 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature tokens, where X is the number of cards that were put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: X is the number of cards put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn, and no Value counts that.

cards.name: Hero of Iroas
lines: Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast this card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
differences: Text A triggers on casting a spell that targets this creature. Text B triggers on casting this card itself, whether or not it targets anything, and does not mention targeting.

cards.name: Legion's Initiative
lines: {R}{W}, Exile this enchantment: Exile all creatures you control. At the beginning of the next combat, return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control and those creatures gain haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot remember the set of creatures exiled by the activation and return that exact set at the beginning of the next combat with haste.

cards.name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
lines: Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell during a turn that isn't yours, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
lines: When ~ enters, mill three cards. Then put X +1/+1 counters on ~, where X is twice the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, mill three cards. Then put two +1/+1 counters on this creature for each creature card in your graveyard.

cards.name: Fire Nation Attacks
lines: Create two 2/2 red Soldier creature tokens with firebending 1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Firebending 1 (an attack-triggered {R} mana grant until end of combat) has no keyword or ability form in the schema, so the tokens cannot carry it.

cards.name: Curse of Unbinding
lines: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield under your control. That player puts the rest of the revealed cards into their graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op reveals the enchanted player's library until a creature card is revealed and puts that card onto the battlefield under your control (revealUntilAura and revealCreatureOrBottom do not match).

cards.name: Ultimecia, Temporal Threat
lines: When ~ enters, tap all creatures your opponents control.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, tap each creature your opponents control.

cards.name: Split Decision
lines: Choose target instant or sorcery spell. Starting with you, each player votes for denial or duplication. If denial gets more votes, counter the spell. If duplication gets more votes or the vote is tied, copy the spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.backTranslation: Each player votes for denial or duplication. If denial gets more votes, counter target instant or sorcery spell. Otherwise, copy target instant or sorcery spell. The copy may have new targets chosen.
differences: Text A has each player vote starting with you; Text B has no starting player, so the voting sequence is not stated.

cards.name: Ruthless Winnower
lines: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a non-Elf creature of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The sacrifice effects (sacrificeEachPlayer, eventPlayerSacrificesPermanents) cannot restrict the sacrificed creature to non-Elf creatures.

cards.name: Fading Hope
lines: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If its mana value was 3 or less, scry 1.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature. If that creature's mana value is 3 or less, scry 1. Then return that creature to its owner's hand.
differences: Text A returns the target creature to its owner's hand first, then checks its mana value for scry 1; Text B checks the mana value and scries first, then returns the creature. The order of steps differs, and for a token the mana value check after it has left the battlefield relies on last known information.

cards.name: Mystic Speculation
lines: Buyback {2}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Buyback is not a kind of optionalAdditionalCost (only kicker, squad, offspring and replicate), and no field returns the spell to its owner's hand as it resolves.

cards.name: Creeping Renaissance
lines: Choose a permanent type. Return all cards of the chosen type from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation:
Choose one —
• Return all artifact cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return all Battle cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return all creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return all enchantment cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return all land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return all planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Rally of Wings
lines: Untap all creatures you control. Creatures you control with flying get +2/+2 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Untap each creature you control.
Creatures you control with flying get +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Pattern of Rebirth
lines: When enchanted creature dies, that creature's controller may search their library for a creature card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: searchLibrary has no player routing, so the search cannot be done by the dying creature's controller (the event player) rather than by you.

cards.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
lines: {2}: Search your library for a Dragon permanent card and put it into your graveyard. If you do, ~ becomes a copy of that card until end of turn. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'If you do, it becomes a copy of that card until end of turn' needs a reference to the searched card and a found-check; becomeCopyOf takes an EffectRef, and searchLibrary's bind is not an EffectRef, and no condition tests whether the search found a card.

cards.name: Search the Premises
lines: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, investigate.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature attacks you, create a token that is an Artifact Clue with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."
differences: Text A triggers on a creature attacking you or a planeswalker you control; Text B triggers only on a creature attacking you and omits attacks on planeswalkers you control.

cards.name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
lines: {2}, {T}: Target opponent gains control of another target permanent you control. If they do, you draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition or effect reading whether the opponent actually gained control, so 'If they do, you draw a card' cannot be tied to the control change.

cards.name: Divert Disaster
lines: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}. If they do, you create a Lander token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: counterUnlessControllerPays cannot run a follow-up effect only when the controller pays, so 'If they do, you create a Lander token' is not expressible.

cards.name: Vision of Love
lines: You may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The choice to sacrifice an artifact or discard a card, with the option to decline, has no schema form for a spell (optional modes are only for triggers).

cards.name: Game of Chaos
lines: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, you gain 1 life and target opponent loses 1 life, and you decide whether to flip again. If you lose the flip, you lose 1 life and that opponent gains 1 life, and that player decides whether to flip again. Double the life stakes with each flip.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The repeated coin flip where each player decides whether to flip again, with the life stakes doubling, has no schema form.

cards.name: Warrior's Oath
lines: Take an extra turn after this one. At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes you lose the game, and a delayed trigger for 'that turn's end step' would fire at the current turn's end step, which comes first.

cards.name: Cyclone Summoner
lines: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, return all permanents to their owners' hands except for Giants, Wizards, and lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'if you cast it from your hand' has no Condition kind (sourceWasCast does not distinguish hand from other zones).

cards.name: Sliver Overlord
lines: {3}: Gain control of target Sliver.
cards.backTranslation: {3}: Gain control of target Sliver permanent. This effect lasts indefinitely.

cards.name: Protection Racket
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, repeat the following process for each opponent in turn order. Reveal the top card of your library. That player may pay life equal to that card's mana value. If they do, exile that card. Otherwise, put it into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The opponent's pay-life choice is priced at the revealed card's mana value, and mayPayLife takes only a fixed amount.

cards.name: Spectra Ward
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from each color. This effect doesn't remove Auras.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from white, from blue, from black, from red, and from green.
differences: Text A says 'This effect doesn't remove Auras.' Text B omits this, so it does not say whether Auras attached to the enchanted creature are removed.

cards.name: Corpse Churn
lines: Mill three cards, then you may return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.effects[1].options[1].effects[0]: executable noOp effects are prohibited; keep the card unsupported instead
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional "you may return a creature card" after the mill cannot be said exactly, because spell effects have no may-decline form and a noOp decline branch is prohibited.

cards.name: Moonsnare Specialist
lines: Ninjutsu {2}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Ninjutsu puts this card from hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and no effect moves the source from hand into combat as an attacker.

cards.name: You Are Already Dead
lines: Destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no target restriction for a creature that was dealt damage this turn: no selector or TargetSpec field tracks damage received this turn.

cards.name: Carrot Cake
lines: When this artifact enters and when you sacrifice it, create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token and scry 1.
cards.backTranslation:
When this artifact enters, create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. Then scry 1.
When this artifact is sacrificed, create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. Then scry 1.

cards.name: Endless Detour
lines: The owner of target spell, nonland permanent, or card in a graveyard puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: One target slot cannot name a spell, a nonland permanent, or a graveyard card together, and no effect makes the target's owner choose top or bottom of the library.

cards.name: Baxter, Fly in the Ointment
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, each creature you control with a counter on it gains flying until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
When this enters, each creature you control that has a counter on it gains flying until end of turn.
Whenever this creature attacks, each creature you control that has a counter on it gains flying until end of turn.

cards.name: Lash of the Balrog
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {4}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost is a choice between sacrificing a creature or paying {4}, and spellAdditionalCosts can only list costs that are all paid together.

cards.name: Anzrag's Rampage
lines: Destroy all artifacts you don't control, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn. You may put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield. It gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no count of the artifacts put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn to set X for the exile, and no way to tie the haste creature returned to hand to the cards exiled this way.

cards.name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if one or more creatures died this turn, you gain that much life and distribute that many +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Distributing that many +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures you control has no effect form.

cards.name: Achilles Davenport
lines: Freerunning {U}{B}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Freerunning alternative cost is only allowed if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with an Assassin or commander, and no Condition kind can express that.

cards.name: Airborne Aid
lines: Draw a card for each Bird on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Draw a card for each Bird permanent, counted across all players' battlefields.

cards.name: Primal Bellow
lines: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Forest you control.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Forests you control.

cards.name: Master of Death
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is in your graveyard, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand. This ability functions while this card is in a graveyard.

cards.name: Vow of Duty
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2, has vigilance, and can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has vigilance.
Enchanted creature can't attack. This restriction also applies to planeswalkers.
differences: Text A says the enchanted creature can't attack you or planeswalkers you control; it can still attack other players and planeswalkers. Text B says the enchanted creature can't attack at all, which is broader.
Text B's 'this restriction also applies to planeswalkers' extends the restriction to planeswalkers in a way that does not match Text A's scope (planeswalkers you control only).

cards.name: Golem-Skin Gauntlets
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each Equipment attached to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no count of the Equipment attached to the equipped creature: countPermanents counts by controller and type, and aurasAttachedToSource counts only Auras.

cards.name: O-Naginata
lines: ~ can be attached only to a creature with power 3 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot restrict which creatures Equipment may be attached to (power 3 or greater); the equip ability's target list is parsed and list fields only append, so the restriction cannot be applied.

cards.name: Feldon's Cane
lines: {T}, Exile this artifact: Shuffle your graveyard into your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that shuffles only the graveyard into the library (shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary also moves the hand).

cards.name: Paladin Danse, Steel Maverick
lines: Exile ~: Each creature you control that's an artifact or Human gains indestructible until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Exile this artifact: Creatures you control that are artifacts or Human creatures gain indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Haunted Fengraf
lines: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Return a creature card at random from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target creature card in your graveyard, chosen at random as this ability is put onto the stack, is put into your hand.
differences: Text A's ability is untargeted: it returns a creature card chosen at random from the graveyard. Text B makes the ability target a creature card in your graveyard, with the random choice made as it goes on the stack, so it is a targeted ability.

cards.name: Duke Ulder Ravengard
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target creature you control gains haste and myriad until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad (token copies tapped and attacking each other opponent, exiled at end of combat) has no keyword or granted-ability form in the schema.

cards.name: Sword of the Meek
lines: Whenever a 1/1 creature you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then attach it to that creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control with base power and toughness 1/1 enters, you may return this Equipment from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to that creature. This ability functions while this card is in a graveyard.
differences: Text A's trigger checks for a creature that is currently a 1/1; Text B checks for a creature with base power and toughness 1/1, so a creature whose power or toughness is modified (for example by +1/+2 from an equipment or a counter) differs between the two.

cards.name: Sokka, Lateral Strategist
lines: Whenever ~ and at least one other creature attack, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks while at least one other creature is attacking, draw a card.

cards.name: Ayara's Oathsworn
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it has fewer than four +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then if it has exactly four +1/+1 counters on it, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if this creature has three or fewer +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. If this creature has exactly four +1/+1 counters on it, search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Excise the Imperfect
lines: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller incubates X, where X is its mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes the exiled permanent's controller incubate a number of counters equal to that permanent's mana value.

cards.name: Greatsword of Tyr
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it and tap up to one target creature defending player controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect taps an "up to one" chosen target creature defending player controls without also goading it, so the tap half cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Pearl of Wisdom
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control an Otter.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {1} less to cast as long as you control a Otter permanent.

cards.name: Littjara Mirrorlake
lines: {2}{G}{G}{U}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf has no way to make the token enter with an additional +1/+1 counter (power/toughness overrides would not be the same as a counter).

cards.name: Denethor, Ruling Steward
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition or value counts creatures that died under your control this turn; creaturesDiedThisTurn counts all creatures.

cards.name: Magus of the Vineyard
lines: At the beginning of each player's first main phase, that player adds {G}{G}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: addMana has no player routing, so the {G}{G} would go to this creature's controller rather than to each player whose first main phase it is (the 'that player adds' clause).

cards.name: Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, defending player sacrifices a creature with the least power among creatures they control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: sacrificeGreatestEachOpponent and sacrificeOneEachOpponent choose the greatest-power or unfiltered creature of each opponent, and there is no 'creature with the least power' sacrifice for the defending player.

cards.name: Glorybringer
lines: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it deals 4 damage to target non-Dragon creature an opponent controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no exert mechanic (the optional exert choice as it attacks and the 'when you do' reflexive trigger that follows).

cards.name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
lines: Sacrifice an artifact: Target artifact gains indestructible until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice another artifact you control: Target artifact gains indestructible until end of turn. This ability can be activated at any time.
differences: Text A lets the sacrifice cost be any artifact, including the source itself; Text B requires sacrificing another artifact you control, so this permanent cannot be sacrificed to pay the cost.

cards.name: Dreamborn Muse
lines: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards in their hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player mills a number equal to the size of that player's own hand: millTargetPlayer takes a fixed number, and the mill op's count is evaluated for the controller, not for the event player.

cards.name: Shatter the Sky
lines: Each player who controls a creature with power 4 or greater draws a card. Then destroy all creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player draws only if they control a creature with power 4 or greater, and the schema has no per-player conditional draw.

cards.name: Spectral Denial
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature you control with power 4 or greater. It has no other effect.
differences: Text A's spell also counters target spell unless its controller pays {X}; Text B says the spell 'has no other effect', omitting the counter effect entirely.

cards.name: Cursecloth Wrappings
lines: {T}: Target creature card in your graveyard gains embalm until end of turn. The embalm cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The embalm cost must equal the targeted card's own mana cost, which is dynamic, and grantAbilityUntilEot cannot grant that embalm ability (exile from graveyard, then a copy token) with a cost read from the target.

cards.name: Curious Colossus
lines: When this creature enters, each creature target opponent controls loses all abilities, becomes a Coward in addition to its other types, and has base power and toughness 1/1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Making the target opponent's creatures lose all abilities and become Cowards with base 1/1 has no permanent (no-duration) effect form; the layer ops are static to the source and the until-end-of-turn ops do not last.

cards.name: Noxious Assault
lines: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second sentence ('Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter') needs a this-turn delayed blocks trigger whose poison recipient is the blocking creature's controller, and the schema does not document that a blocks trigger's eventPlayer is that controller.

cards.name: Locket of Yesterdays
lines: Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each card with the same name as that spell in your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The costReduction amount is a Value with no count of cards in your graveyard sharing the name of the spell being cast, so 'for each card with the same name' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Moldgraf Monstrosity
lines: When this creature dies, exile it, then return two creature cards at random from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no op that returns a random selection of creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield (graveyardToBattlefieldEach returns all matches and returnOneFromYourGraveyardToBattlefield is a choice).

cards.name: Lavaclaw Reaches
lines: {1}{B}{R}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/2 black and red Elemental creature with "{X}: ~ gets +X/+0 until end of turn." It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted ability '{X}: This creature gets +X/+0' needs the X announced for an activated ability, but the schema documents the xValue Value only for spells (CR 601.2b), so the X cannot be shown to be read in an activated ability.

cards.name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
lines: You may pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can express an alternative cost only on the card's own casting (alternativeCasts) or on permanent spells (energyAlternativeCost), not a static letting you pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} for every spell you cast.

cards.name: Rolling Earthquake
lines: ~ deals X damage to each creature without horsemanship and each player.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Excluding creatures with horsemanship needs a keyword check, but the engine's keyword list only holds implemented keywords, so a horsemanship creature could not be excluded from the damage.

cards.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
lines: Sacrifice ~: When target creature is put into your graveyard this turn, return that card to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A delayed trigger that watches the targeted creature for any put-into-graveyard event, then returns that exact card, cannot be bound to the chosen target in the schema.

cards.name: Shock Brigade
lines: Mobilize 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mobilize's created token must be sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step, and no TokenSpec field, delayed-trigger form or effect can sacrifice the just-created token (createTokenCopyOf's sacrificeAt applies only to copies).

cards.name: Timber Protector
lines: Other Treefolk and Forests you control have indestructible.
cards.backTranslation: Each other permanent you control with the subtype Treefolk or Forest has indestructible.

cards.name: Eladamri's Vineyard
lines: At the beginning of each player's first main phase, that player adds {G}{G}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: addMana has no player routing, so a trigger for each player's first main phase would add the mana to the Vineyard's controller rather than to that player (the active player).

cards.name: Dragonlord Kolaghan
lines: Whenever an opponent casts a creature or planeswalker spell with the same name as a card in their graveyard, that player loses 10 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no selector for a spell sharing a name with a card in its caster's graveyard, so the opponent's same-name casting trigger cannot be matched.

cards.name: Gleeful Demolition
lines: Destroy target artifact. If you controlled that artifact, create three 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens.
cards.backTranslation:
If the target artifact is controlled by you, create three 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens. Otherwise, nothing happens.
Destroy target artifact.
differences: Step order is reversed: Text A destroys the target artifact first and then checks whether you controlled it (last known information) to create the three Goblins; Text B checks control of the target and creates the Goblins before it destroys the artifact. The order of steps matters, so these differ.
Text A's condition is checked after the artifact is destroyed; Text B's condition is checked while the artifact is still on the battlefield, before destruction.

cards.name: Phyrexian Atlas
lines: Whenever this artifact becomes tapped, each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition on an opponent's poison counter count, so 'each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life' cannot be restricted per opponent.

cards.name: Transmogrifying Wand
lines: {1}, {T}, Remove a charge counter from this artifact: Destroy target creature. Its controller creates a 2/4 white Ox creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}, Remove a charge counter from this: Destroy target creature. Its controller creates a white Ox creature token with power 2 and toughness 4. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Pym Particles
lines: Target creature gains vigilance until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature gains vigilance until end of turn. It can't be blocked this turn.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Signature Slam
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then each modified creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Modified creature' (counters, Equipment, or Auras you control) and each such creature dealing damage equal to its own power have no exact selector or amount form.

cards.name: Battlefield Improvisation
lines: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If that creature is attacking, you may attach any number of Equipment you control to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional attachment of any number of Equipment you control to the target creature has no schema form, since attach moves only the source or the trigger object.

cards.name: Verdurous Gearhulk
lines: When this creature enters, distribute four +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Distributing a total of four +1/+1 counters among the chosen creatures has no effect form; putCountersEachChosen places the same count on each.

cards.name: Confusion in the Ranks
lines: Whenever an artifact, creature, or enchantment enters, its controller chooses target permanent another player controls that shares a card type with it. Exchange control of those permanents.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that exchanges control of two permanents (one chosen by its controller, sharing a card type) as a triggered reaction to an artifact, creature, or enchantment entering.

cards.name: Armed and Armored
lines: Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn. Choose a Dwarf you control. Attach any number of Equipment you control to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes all Vehicles you control artifact creatures until end of turn (becomeCreatureUntilEot is single-target) and no way to choose a Dwarf and attach any number of Equipment you control to it.

cards.name: Trap the Trespassers
lines: Each player secretly votes for a creature you don't control, then those votes are revealed. For each creature with one or more votes, put that many stun counters on it, then tap it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no secret vote among all players whose per-creature vote counts place stun counters; councilVote only takes a fixed pair of named choices and is not secret.

cards.name: Smellerbee, Rebel Fighter
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw cards equal to the number of attacking creatures.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, you may discard your hand, then draw a number of cards equal to the number of attacking creatures you control.

cards.name: Blood Fountain
lines: When this artifact enters, create a Blood token.
cards.backTranslation: When this artifact enters, create a Blood artifact token. It has "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."

cards.name: Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers
lines: Whenever ~ attack, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect reveals cards until a creature card is found and puts that card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

cards.name: Chance for Glory
lines: Creatures you control gain indestructible. Take an extra turn after this one. At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes you lose the game, and a delayed trigger for 'that turn's end step' would fire at the current turn's end step, which comes first.

cards.name: Stonehorn Dignitary
lines: When this creature enters, target opponent skips their next combat phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a player skip their next combat phase.

cards.name: The Red Terror
lines: Advanced Species — Whenever a red source you control deals damage to one or more permanents and/or players, put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger watches damage dealt by a red source you control to permanents and/or players, so the 'red source' damage trigger cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Silklash Spider
lines: {X}{G}{G}: ~ deals X damage to each creature with flying.
cards.backTranslation: {X}{G}{G}: Deal X damage to each creature with flying.

cards.name: Wandering Fumarole
lines: {2}{U}{R}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 1/4 blue and red Elemental creature with "{0}: Switch this creature's power and toughness until end of turn." It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted ability '{0}: Switch this creature's power and toughness until end of turn' needs an effect that switches power and toughness, and no Effect op in the schema does that.

cards.name: Gravespawn Sovereign
lines: Tap five untapped Zombies you control: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.backTranslation: Tap five Zombies you control (this creature may be one of them): Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield.
differences: Text A puts the target creature card onto the battlefield under your control; Text B does not say under whose control the creature enters.

cards.name: Velomachus Lorehold
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to ~'s power from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. Choose an instant or sorcery card among them with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
differences: Text A says 'You may cast' an instant or sorcery, so casting is optional. Text B says 'Choose ... and cast it', which is mandatory.
Text A puts the rest of the top seven cards on the bottom of the library in a random order. Text B has no clause for the remaining cards.

cards.name: Faceless Haven
lines: {S}{S}{S}: ~ becomes a 4/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The {S}{S}{S} snow mana activation cost has no schema form (ParsedManaCost cannot hold snow symbols), and becomeCreatureUntilEot grants listed subtypes only, not all creature types.

cards.name: Heroes' Bane
lines: {2}{G}{G}: Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is its power.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{G}{G}: Put a number of +1/+1 counters on this creature equal to its power.
